summary: Max Verstappen converted pole position into Red Bull's first win of the season, pulling clear despite unprecedented software glitches that disrupted qualifying and forced multiple race delays in Malaysia. Carlos Sainz called for F1 to conduct a thorough examination of itself following the technical failures, while Verstappen and Lewis Hamilton compared the chaotic conditions to driving a "Lego race." Verstappen's victory extends his championship lead as heat-hazard conditions continue to challenge the grid for the third time this season.
